resource.title: Introduction to Software Security（UW-Madison，Barton P. Miller & Elisa R. Heymann；免费开放教材＋课程模块，单章可在线看）
resource.covers: Module 2 安全设计（Secure Design Principles、威胁建模 SDL / DREAD / PASTA）、Module 3 安全编码（指针与字符串、整数/浮点数值错误、目录穿越、异常、序列化、各类注入与 XSS/CSRF/会话/CORS/SSRF）、Module 4 防御技术（ASLR、内存安全检查、CFI）、Module 5 FPVA 第一原理漏洞评估（架构分析、资源识别、信任与权限分析、组件分析、结果发布 = 代码审查方法论）、Module 6 自动化评估工具（静态分析工具概念、依赖分析工具）、Module 7 动态技术（fuzz testing 原理、命令行/GUI 研究、AFL++）、Chapter 35 漏洞响应（修复与管理者视角）。

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: Fundamental programming skills, including familiarity with C and Python 3. In more detail: For C, the student should know how pointers and dynamic memories work. The student should know how to develop basic algorithms/data structures ... Basic Notions in Linux System Administration: ... Understand the difference between user space and kernel space. Some interest/knowledge of logic and modeling: Understand propositional and first-order logic. Understand linear-time temporal logic.
Prerequisite(s): COP 3415 - Data Structures or COP 3530 - Data Structures & Algorithms

extra_prereqs.evidence: Manchester COMP63342 要求熟悉 C，“the student should know how pointers and dynamic memories work”
Manchester COMP63342 要求 “familiarity with C and Python 3”
Manchester COMP63342 要求会写 “basic algorithms/data structures”；Florida Poly CEN 4033 先修 Data Structures
Manchester COMP63342 要求 “Basic Notions in Linux System Administration ... user space and kernel space”
Manchester COMP63342 要求 “Understand propositional and first-order logic”
Manchester COMP63342 要求 “Understand linear-time temporal logic”（LTL 通常出现在模型检查/验证课）

notes: 主资源是 UW-Madison 的开放课程网站：全书各章（含静态分析工具概念、fuzz testing 与 AFL++、FPVA 代码审查方法）都能在浏览器里直接看，正文与 slides 免费，符合“网站优先”。原图建议前置 P.4.5（软件测试、质量与可靠性）在两门课的先修说明里都没有出现：Manchester 只在“Relationship to other courses”里提到 test-driven development，佛罗里达理工只写 Data Structures，所以记 not_mentioned。另注：RIT SE 331 “Engineering Secure Software” 的主题列表与本节点几乎一一对应（security in requirements engineering / fuzzing / static analysis），但其 syllabus 只写 “Prerequisite: SE362”，无法核实 SE362 的内容，故未采用。
